title: Retrospective fraud loss is followed by mixed material and institutional responses in a linked HTOPS panel
source_unit: April-to-June 2025 Census HTOPS public-use respondents linked by exact SCRAMID; same-respondent descriptive follow-up, not a representative incident sample or attrition-adjusted causal panel

observations.period: April 15–29 to June 16–25, 2025; retrospective fraud/loss groups followed to later material and institutional responses

denominator.unit: exact SCRAMID-linked respondents across April and June files; outcome-specific valid denominators vary

linked_group_counts.value: no exposure 751; exposure 5,798; exposure plus money loss 184; loss plus report 51; loss, report, and agency recovery 11
linked_group_counts.unit: unweighted linked respondents; groups are non-equivalent valid-answer universes

later_material_context.value: June unable-to-pay-energy-bill share: no exposure 16.84%; exposure 10.66%; exposure plus loss 43.81%; loss plus report 44.86%; loss/report/recovery 78.80%
later_material_context.unit: April-weighted descriptive percent among valid June outcomes

later_institutional_response.value: June code-1 share for federal-statistics trust: no exposure 68.60%; exposure 72.43%; exposure plus loss 58.07%; loss plus report 70.20%; loss/report/recovery 65.70%. June code-1 Congress confidence: 13.35%, 3.93%, 4.84%, 0.80%, and 0.00%, respectively.
later_institutional_response.unit: April-weighted coded-response shares; code labels retained without translating code 1 into high trust

recovery_subgroup.unit: linked respondents reporting loss, reporting, and agency recovery; descriptive boundary cell

observations.method: Exact SCRAMID linkage between April 2025 fraud-module and June 2025 HTOPS files; April PWEIGHT applied to linked respondents; outcome-specific valid rows retained. Replicate variance is not used because an attrition-adjusted longitudinal weight is not documented.
observations.uncertainty: April fraud questions refer to the prior 12 months rather than a dated incident. The actor, alternatives, effort, remedy timing, prior trust, and political action are not observed. Linked retention is selective, outcome missingness varies, and the loss/report/recovery cell has only 11 respondents. Code-1 institutional measures remain dictionary-dependent coding screens.
observations.subgroup: Linked respondents grouped by reported April scam exposure, money loss, reporting, and agency recovery; groups are distinct valid-answer universes and are not a progression with equal denominators.
observations.counterinterpretation: Fraud exposure alone is not equivalent to realized loss, and realized loss is not equivalent to general expense difficulty. Mixed later trust patterns may reflect prior identity, institution-specific judgment, selection, reporting, or unrelated conditions rather than a fraud effect.

related_sources.claim: Census publishes the HTOPS/HPS public-use data and documentation route used for the April-to-June linked panel.
The committed linkage audit and result JSON document the exact SCRAMID intersection, groups, weights, outcomes, and boundary.

boundary: This is an associative same-respondent follow-up, not a causal fraud effect or political-action estimate. It does not establish a dated incident, actor responsibility, trust change, remedy receipt, recovery, switching, or exit.

reproduction_audit.retrieval_hash_scope: Existing committed HTOPS April/June input hashes and local result JSON; raw PUFs are not retained in the repository
